after: always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
proposal.description: The soft-start trip is made sticky: once window_trip_SS fires it stays latched until ss_active falls, instead of following fault_count_ss against trip_ss.
proposal.reason: While the module stays in S_SS after a trip, window_trip_SS should fall once fault_count_ss drops below trip_ss, either because faulted cycles roll out of the 32-cycle window or because trip_ss is raised. With this fault it stays high for the rest of S_SS.

after: always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
else if (!ss_active) begin trip_ss_q <= trip_ss; end
proposal.description: The soft-start threshold is captured on entry to S_SS and held for the whole soft start, instead of trip_ss being compared live.
proposal.reason: If TRIP_SS is changed during S_SS, window_trip_SS keeps using the old value: lowering trip_ss to the present count or below does not trip, and raising it above the count does not release the trip, until S_SS is entered again.
